newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT down on KDD undersea cable report.
newsitem.headline: NTT down on KDD undersea cable report.

text.p: Shares of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) fell in Tuesday morning trade, depressed by a newspaper report that Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) will lay an undersea optical fibre cable by the summer of 1999, traders said.
They said such a move could reduce KDD's reliance on NTT's vast networks in the future.
NTT shares were down 3,000 yen at 817,000 yen at 0115 GMT. Volume was 1,655 shares.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun economic daily said on Tuesday that KDD, an international telecommunications operator, will invest about 100 billion yen to lay an undersea optical fibre cable around the main Japanese islands of Honshu, Shikoku and Kyushu.
The paper also said the move was in line with KDD's wish to offer domestic telephone services.
The 8,500 km cable will have a capacity of 100 gigabits, or 1.2 million phone lines, the paper said.
A KDD spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
